title: Shop Header / Open Cart on Cart-Click
description:
When clicking on the cart icon in the shop header i expect the offcanvas cart to open, showing an empy cart. The cart-state should be passed into the cart component as prop. Empty cart is default.

summary: Shop header cart icon click triggers offcanvas cart with current or empty state.
shortDescription: This enhancement connects the shop header cart icon to the offcanvas cart drawer component. Clicking the cart icon opens the slide-in panel displaying the current cart contents or an empty cart state when no items exist. The cart state is passed as a prop allowing the header and cart components to remain synchronized. This provides users with quick cart access from any page without navigating away.
